task: canonical facet state under probability=1.0 + size floor (R1)

states.reason: one sample from a distribution: produced by a nondeterministic fit, and its geometry was never written to disk, so it is permanently unrecoverable. Its files stay on disk as the evidence of the defect.

states.status: SUPERSEDED, not overwritten; its files remain
states.reason: three defects were fixed after it: blob candidates were selected by bounding box, so two facets owned 9,739 of the same points; min_pitch=10 was deleting real low-slope roof; and the coverage denominator was eroded with its holes still in it, discarding 32.5 percent of the footprint. The change in coverage between the two states is decomposed cause by cause in attribution-2026-07-26.json.

supersedes.rule: supersede, never overwrite. A corrected file implies the old numbers were an arithmetic mistake; they were not, they were correct computations under a defective definition, and that distinction is the finding.

replay.how: np.load(roof.npy) -> level_cloud(...) -> points; then points[npz['facet_k']] rebuilds facet k exactly.
replay.index_frame: row numbers into the LEVELED roof point array; leveling is a rotation, so row order is unchanged from roof.npy
replay.index_check: points[idx] compared to the fitted points bit for bit (np.array_equal on float64) before this file was written; a mismatch aborts the run

params.min_pitch_note: 5, not 10. min_pitch is a DEFINITION of what counts as a roof, not a filter; see decisions/2026-07-26-min-pitch-definition-not-filter.md
params.min_points_hard_form: 3704 x d, d = measured point density

filled_holes.reading: largest single filled region is 2.3458 cu^2. If that is a meaningful fraction of the roof, check it against the imagery before trusting the filled footprint: a real courtyard or light well would look exactly like this.

density_testable_fraction.question: how much of the footprint has enough points to test at all
density_testable_fraction.kind: CAPTURE quality: the flight and the reconstruction, not the segmentation

facet_coverage.question: of the testable region, how much does a facet explain
facet_coverage.kind: SEGMENTATION: this is what the coverage gate was built to measure

coverage.note: these two do not multiply to the old single number, and are not meant to. The old number mixed a capture shortfall into a segmentation score against a base that hole-erosion had already shrunk by a third.

main_facet_hash_check.what: sha256(sorted int64 index array || plane_abcd_hex || centroid_hex), compared at full stored precision
main_facet_hash_check.why: pitch and area are functions of these, so hashing them too would add no information and could fail for reasons unrelated to facet identity

single_ownership_check.what: no point index appears in two facets' index arrays
single_ownership_check.why: permanent, every run, fails loudly. Only possible because R1 persists inlier indices.
